headline: Quantum Computing and Advanced Metrology Frontiers
summary: Today's research spans quantum enhancements in machine learning architectures, non-reciprocal out-of-equilibrium physical systems, and fundamental bounds in quantum metrology and photonics. These developments highlight both practical scaling methods for hybrid models and strict theoretical limits in quantum estimation.

themes.title: Quantum Machine Learning & Estimation
themes.body: Exploring the integration of quantum heads into foundational time-series models for improved classification accuracy, alongside theoretical investigations into parametric amplification and feedback control for enhanced multiparameter quantum estimation.

themes.title: Out-of-Equilibrium Systems & Metrology Limits
themes.body: Analyzing non-reciprocally interacting Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes to reveal exceptional points and pseudo-equilibrium, while also establishing fundamental limits showing that indefinite causal order yields no asymptotic precision advantage over parallel strategies in metrology.

themes.title: Advanced Photonic Sources
themes.body: Advancing deterministic single-photon generation to achieve unprecedented in-fibre fluxes exceeding 500 MHz, and utilizing coincidence-based spectral filtering to overcome spectral matching challenges in cascaded downconversion.
